backchannels.direction: Oo shows the line is heard; mao diay marks uptake; a clipped sige sige can sound like cutting in.

reactions.direction: Tuod? flags surprise; ikasubo nako is sympathy; pahalipay congratulates, as listed on Omniglot.

cant_hear.direction: That Peace Corps list has no weak-line cue; say dili ko kadungog nimo, then ask for a slightly louder voice.

examples.text: Dili ko kadungog nimo og klaro.

ask_repeat.direction: Usba palihog is the courtesy list's replay request; for a name or 12345678, ask only that part again.

examples.text: Palihog usba ang numero: 12345678 ba ni?

who_is_calling.direction: The Peace Corps telephone list uses kinsa 'ni, palihog?; on a shared handset, say this is {owner}'s phone.

wrong_number.direction: No fixed wrong-number line in that list; a short sayop nga numero, and nobody of that name, is enough.

relay.direction: Palihog sultihi nga mitawag is the listed way to pass a message; do not name a time when {owner} will ring back.

examples.text: Akong sultihan si {owner} nga mitawag ka.

sales_decline.direction: A brief wala koy kinahanglan or dili ko interesado is enough; no long excuse is required.

examples.text: Salamat, pero wala koy kinahanglan ani.

firm_no.direction: When the offer is repeated, restate the no with gyud and ask them not to call again about that offer.

examples.text: Klaro na: dili gyud ko moapalit.
Ayaw na kog tawagi ani nga tanyag.

address_forms.direction: Kamo is the honorific you in Wiktionary; Sir or Ma'am is common with strangers; ka stays among familiars.

avoid_service_phrases.direction: Calques of BPO lines such as ang imong tawag importante kanamo sound like a hotline, out of place on a home line.

examples.text: Ang imong tawag importante kaayo kanamo.
Unsa may akong ikatabang nimo karon?
Salamat sa pagtawag sa among linya.

taboo_on_phone.direction: Asking minyo ka na or pay on a first stranger call feels nosy; so does dropping kamo with elders.

examples.text: Minyo ka na? Pilay imong sweldo?
Sulti og tanan nimo nga numero sa bangko.

uncertain: 未找到宿霧語私人電話相槌頻率表（本機 freq/ceb.txt 為 404）；oo／mao diay／sige 依會話習慣，不是語料庫排序。
Peace Corps／ERIC 電話課含叫人在線上短暫停留的句子，本檔依規定不用。
城市口語常夾英語或他加祿語 po／opo；傳統敬語靠 kamo 與 palihog。代接陌生人時本檔先用 kamo，不以 po 為預設。
「打錯電話」該課沒有固定對譯，例句依 sayop nga numero 的普通說法，並列入不確定。
